parent_objective: audit materialized four-wheel source intervention artifacts before policy-side use
blocked_by: M1277 materialized preferred/rejected source artifacts but result quality must be audited before replay or actor integration
supersedes: direct policy training from M1277 artifacts

public_gates: M1278 must preserve actor input contract
M1278 must not use private holdout
M1278 must audit observation cleanliness and preferred/rejected outcome quality
M1278 must select the next source-intervention step before actor/Gym integration
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add per-wheel/fault labels to actor observations
do not treat materialized artifacts as driver performance
do not claim self-identification from source materialization
do not claim high-fidelity validation from the compact pilot

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits whether M1277 source-intervention artifacts are clean and suitable for the next source-intervention step
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit only; no training, promotion, private-holdout, paper-level, recurrent-belief, high-fidelity, or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if preferred/rejected outcome checks are weak
stop if next step would require actor-input expansion
fallback_plan: if artifacts are suitable, admit replay/policy-side design
if artifacts are unsuitable, route to materialization repair or source-corpus repair
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1277 produced source-intervention artifacts that require audit before use

training_stage.stage_objective: four-wheel source intervention materialization result audit
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
one next manifest if audit admits it

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1278 audits source artifacts only and does not test actor history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: future actor history tests remain blocked until materialized artifacts are connected to a policy/intervention gate
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If materialized artifacts are unsuitable, repair artifacts before policy-side use.
allowed_claims: four-wheel source intervention materialization result audit
no recurrent-belief, strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: The M1277 materialized source-intervention artifacts can be audited for observation cleanliness and preferred/rejected outcome quality before policy-side use.
success_criteria: audit cites M1277 intervention observation and action-sequence counts
audit selects the next source-intervention step
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: audit treats materialized artifacts as driver performance
audit skips directly to actor/Gym integration
training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
decision_rule: M1278 passes if it audits M1277 source-intervention artifacts and selects the next source-intervention step without training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion.
